description: This file defines an ErrorBoundary React component that catches JavaScript errors in child components and renders a fallback UI. It includes state handling and error logging functionality.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component class extending React.Component that manages error state and renders fallback UI upon encountering errors.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component's state, setting hasError to false.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromError
methods.description: Static method that updates state when an error is caught, setting hasError to true and storing the error.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: Logs the error to the console; can be extended to add external error reporting.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns fallback UI if an error has occurred; otherwise, renders child components.
